title: Compact error cards + microcopy variants for onboarding quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a small set of reusable, production-ready UX assets and documentation screenshots for onboarding and quickstart flows that explain rate limits, timeouts, and automatic retries. Assets should be compact visual cards and inline help panels that can be embedded in product docs, the quickstart wizard, and the Console when users hit transient failures. Deliverables: SVG + PNG art assets, animated GIF for retry flow, microcopy variants for different severity levels, accessibility-compliant color tokens, and screenshot guidance for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Three compact visual card variants (info, warning, critical) for rate limit/timeout/retry that match Console design tokens
Microcopy set with 3 tone variants (friendly, neutral, technical) and examples for copy truncation at 80/120 characters
SVGs exported with accessible title/desc tags and PNGs at 1x/2x @ recommended sizes
Animated 3-frame GIF demonstrating retry backoff and fallback to alternative model (looped, <3s total)
Documentation screenshot template for product docs with callout annotations and recommended alt text
Figma file with component variants and a single source of truth for color tokens and spacing
Design review signoff from PM and Eng, and a linked implementation task in GitHub
Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text on all card variants and WCAG notes added

decisions: Prefer compact card format (horizontal, single-line title + 1-line body) to minimize vertical space in the quickstart wizard
Use a single, system icon set (outlined for info, filled for warnings/critical) to reduce asset permutations
Retry animation will demonstrate exponential backoff and then show fallback suggestion after 2 attempts
Tone for default microcopy: neutral with an optional friendly variant for marketing-led onboarding
Deliver assets with SVG accessibility tags and separate alt text files for translators
